_comment: Variation of guard-parked-escort-exit for display.c see_monsters(): the Valkyrie first wishes for and wears a helm of telepathy, then follows the vault guard's escort until gd_move_cleanup() parks it at <0,0>. After postmov()'s newsym(0,0) report, every later input reaches allmain.c's once-per-input see_monsters() for an unblind telepathic hero, whose loop still meets the parked guard on fmon and calls newsym(0,0) again, so impossible() prints its three messages after each keystroke, including the ones C reports as unknown commands.
